t: 110 лет Транссибу: Как строили самую длинную в мире железную дорогу

de: On October 5 (18), 1916, traffic on the Amur Bridge opened - at that time the longest in all of Eurasia. This date became a turning point in the history of the country: the Great Siberian Way finally freed from Manchurian dependence…

te: Amur Bridge and Trans-Siberian Railway: completion of highway construction - Homeland
de: In 1916, through traffic on the Trans-Siberian Railway was opened without the use of CVZhD. How the construction of the Amur Railway changed the transport system of the Russian Empire and the development of the Far East.
